coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 3 of 7 ground-truth variable categories at a broad semantic level (43%): training regime, game-rule variation, and reasoning benchmark performance. The latter two matches have important implementation omissions or discrepancies.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Uses Llama-3/Qwen instead of varying LLaMA-2-7B and Baichuan-2-13B. Specifies batch size 64 rather than 128 and omits maximum sequence length 2048 and explicit fixed dataset splits. Does not vary learning rates and KL coefficients across the specified SPAG, imitation-learning, and Alpaca baselines. Omits several required benchmarks and replaces geometric mean with arithmetic macro-average. Game rewards are specified, but attacker/defender win rates and non-adversarial success metrics are not explicitly measured. Adds unsupported Taboo mechanics and extra experimental conditions.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion_output is empty, so it does not semantically match the expected conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Fails to state that adversarial SPAG is expected to outperform non-adversarial approaches.
